@site/docs/intro.md: Follow a complete MuddyWater CTI-to-detection workflow: assess sources, model procedures in OpenCTI, engineer rules, and validate them in a live lab.

@site/docs/pipeline.md: Trace six phases from source collection and procedure modeling through OpenCTI, detection engineering, lab validation, proof capture, and coverage scoring.
